account.billSub: Manage your pass status and cancellation.
account.billNoneHint: Buy a pass in Pricing and it shows here.
account.cancelDesc: Pick how to cancel. You keep access until the period ends.
account.cancelEndDesc: Use until {date}, then it ends. No refund.
account.cancelNowUnknown: Cannot compute the refund. Try again later.
account.refundFull: Unused within 7 days of payment: full {amount} refund.
account.refundZero: Nothing left after {days} used days. The pass just ends now.
account.withdrawDesc: Deleting removes your profile, plays, and playlists at once and cannot be undone. Pending payouts follow the terms.
